recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-17923 unless a future FM decision changes Claim unitPrice semantics beyond this wording correction.
issue_request: FHIR-17923 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Claim issue from STU3 asking that Claim.item.unitPrice, Claim.item.detail.unitPrice, and Claim.item.detail.subDetail.unitPrice replace 'point' with 'unit' or 'element' in the description.
initial_application: Historical commit afb5ec66f6 explicitly listed 17923 in a Claim batch and changed the old spreadsheet unitPrice wording from 'Fee, charge or cost per point' to 'Fee, charge or cost per item', with requirements text using 'a single unit'.
additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini. The current build-scope Claim StructureDefinition source has the corrected 'per item' and 'single unit' wording for all three requested unitPrice elements. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found. Jira neighborhood search found FHIR-5165, but that older datatype comparator issue only mentions Claim unitPrice as background Money/Quantity inventory and does not change this wording decision.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because the current authoritative Claim source already matches the issue intent and a targeted Claim XML search found no remaining point-based unitPrice wording.

related_jiras.note: Older datatype comparator issue mentions Claim unitPrice Money elements, but it is not the same wording-change family.
